text: The meeting established the plan to produce a written project plan including functional and technical designs, staffing, timeline, budget, and market plan by two weeks, in line with the decisions to deliver within two weeks and cover both design and budgeting aspects.
Actions were defined to determine the functional design and discuss it with Ed, and to prepare a project plan by the next meeting.
A problem was raised about confusion on the project goal, with some participants expecting a remote control and others expecting a monitor.
Decisions were made that the PM will present the plan to management with costs and timeline, aligning with the two-week delivery deadline.
The team agreed that copies of slides and emails should be circulated to attendees and to MIO086 as part of documentation.
